name: OpenClaw Mesh
description: Stateful, Ed25519-signed agent-to-agent mesh messaging for OpenClaw; also bridges to Hermes mesh peers

routingAgent.description: mesh agent name this bridge accepts messages for

sourceChannel.description: Channel to attribute the injected turn to (e.g. telegram, mesh). Use mesh for direct routing to the configured session.

sourceTo.description: Channel target/to (e.g. Telegram chat id) for the injected turn

model.description: Optional explicit provider/model override for the embedded agent run (e.g. deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro)

inboxPath.description: Path to the durable inbox file

mirrorInbound.description: Where to mirror inbound mesh messages. 'none' disables mirroring, 'telegram' sends via the configured Telegram bot, 'cli' logs to stdout.

mirrorOutbound.description: Where to mirror outbound mesh messages. 'none' disables mirroring, 'telegram' sends via the configured Telegram bot, 'cli' logs to stdout.

meshVaultPath.description: Path to the mesh vault root (directory that contains mesh/agents/<agent>/identity.yaml)

debug.description: Emit verbose debug logs to stderr and /tmp/openclaw-mesh-debug.log

allowLoopback.description: Allow outbound webhook deliveries to loopback/private addresses

privateNetworkPolicy.description: Private network policy for outbound webhook delivery

auditLogPath.description: Path to the append-only audit log (JSON lines)

deliveryRetries.description: Number of outbound webhook delivery attempts

registryUrl.description: URL of the mesh-peer-registry server (used for mesh_sync and mesh_publish)

privateKeyPath.description: Path to the Ed25519 private key PEM; defaults to ~/.mesh/keys/<agent>.pem

signTimestamp.description: Include X-Mesh-Timestamp in the signed outbound payload

allowInsecureRegistry.description: Allow http:// registry URLs (not recommended for production)

registryPin.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the registry server certificate SPKI for TLS pinning
